title: RIVETER Measuring Power and Social Dynamics Between Entities

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting entities from the novel Pride and Prejudice and comparing the verb connotation power scores associated with feminine versus masculine pronoun groups to see which genders are framed as having or lacking power.

Generating short stories with GPT-3.5 using prompts that feature dyadic role pairs with predetermined power asymmetries (e.g., boss/subordinate, landlord/tenant, doctor/patient) and calculating the differences in verb-based power scores assigned to the higher and lower power roles.
